title: Cross-board electrical interface is only a signal-class proposal
component_interface: Board A to Board B power/audio/control/safety interface
description: The product lists interface signal classes but not validated voltage/timing, pin count, fault polarity, return allocation or power-off behavior. A controlled interface freeze needs those details.

evidence.note: Signal classes are proposed; exact pinout waits for schematic freeze.
Clock/data endpoint capabilities and candidate 3.3-V domains verified; physical electrical contract still needs R3.

R3 disposition: R3 freezes the ten active electrical signal classes, polarity/mastership, 3.3-V nominal domains, contact floor, default/off behavior and responsibilities. R4 must prove loaded timing, current/contact sizing, isolation and safe-state circuit details. Earlier R1 criterion remains in repository history. Prior R1 status=open, blocker=R3, closure criterion: Produce a versioned interface contract with source/sink and logic levels, audio mastership/format/timing, I2C pullups, 5 V/return current, mute/fault/PGOOD default states, startup/shutdown and disconnected-board behavior; independently verify endpoints before R3 PASS. Keep connector mechanics separate.
R4 preflight reviewed this finding. R4 electrical closure remains blocked; no R5 schematic approval.

Public official evidence and conditional calculations reviewed; closure criterion is not yet satisfied. Current NXP RM Rev 4 / HW Guide Rev 7 access restriction applies to the RT1062 portions. Finding remains blocking, with original history preserved.

evidence.location: section 10, authorized-manual and owner-input closure audit, 2026-09-30
evidence.note: NXP RM Rev 4 identifies exact SAI roots/clock frequencies and pins. Loaded per-signal DC, timing, off-domain behavior and 5-V/return-contact proof remain incomplete.

closure_criterion: Prove 5-V/return current and drop, serial-audio loaded timing and levels, I2C/off-state isolation, AMP_MUTE/FAULT/PGOOD polarity and response in the R4 implementation before schematic readiness.
resolved_by: R3 architecture disposition; later closure required
resolution: R3 freezes the ten active electrical signal classes, polarity/mastership, 3.3-V nominal domains, contact floor, default/off behavior and responsibilities. R4 must prove loaded timing, current/contact sizing, isolation and safe-state circuit details.
